title: Public Sector AI Knowledge & Microservices Modernization Platform
raw_rfp_text:
Solicitation Ref: DDT-2026-AI-01
Title: Public Sector AI Knowledge & Microservices Modernization Platform
Issuing Organization: Department of Digital Transformation
Estimated Budget: $1,500,000 USD
Submission Deadline: 2026-12-15
Location: Washington D.C. / Hybrid

Eligibility Requirements:
1. Vendor must demonstrate at least 10 years of enterprise cloud engineering experience.
2. Vendor must maintain at least 50 full-time engineering personnel.

Technical Requirements:
1. Backend API must be built with Python FastAPI microservices and Pydantic validation.
2. Storage layer must implement PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector semantic search and HNSW indexing.
3. Frontend portal built in React with containerized Docker and Kubernetes deployment.

Required Certifications:
1. Active ISO 27001:2022 Information Security Management certification.
2. Active SOC 2 Type II attestation.

Deliverables:
1. Production RAG microservice codebase and Terraform IaC modules.
2. 24/7 Tier-3 SRE support documentation with 99.9% uptime SLA.

Evaluation Criteria:
- Technical Architecture (60%)
- Past Performance (25%)
- Price (15%)
expected_requirements: 10 years of enterprise cloud engineering experience
Python FastAPI microservices and Pydantic validation
PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector semantic search and HNSW indexing
React frontend with Docker and Kubernetes deployment

requirements_labeled.description: Vendor must have at least 10 years of documented cloud engineering experience and 50+ full-time staff.
Microservices backend engineered using Python FastAPI with Pydantic v2 validation.
PostgreSQL 16 database with pgvector HNSW cosine similarity search for RAG.
Active ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II certifications.
